title: Galician Seafood Paella
description: A classic Spanish dish from the Galicia region, featuring juicy seafood, savory spices, and aromatic saffron. This paella is perfect for a seafood lover's dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the anchovy fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly browned.
Add the galician shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes, until pink and cooked through.
Add the mussels and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they open.
Add the paella rice and stir to combine with the seafood and spices.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the saffron threads and smoked paprika.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
